title: 2.1 Rates of Change and the Derivative

icans: I can use the definition to find the derivative of a function at a number.
I can write an equation of the tangent line to a graph.
I can interpret the derivative as a velocity or a rate of change.

vocab: f′(c) = the limit as x → c of (f(x) − f(c))/(x − c), if the limit __________
the line __________ (c, f(c)) with slope f′(c)
the _____________ of the position function, v(t₀) = s′(t₀)
the _____________ f′(c): how fast f changes with respect to x at c

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Derivative at c: f′(c) = the limit as x → c of _______________, if the limit exists.

blocks.stem: Use the definition to find f′(2) for f(x) = 2x² − 5x.

notes: Tangent line at (c, f(c)): y − f(c) = _______________(x − c).

blocks.stem: Find an equation of the tangent line to f(x) = x³ at (1, 1).

notes: Velocity: if s(t) is the position, the instantaneous velocity at t₀ is _______________.
Rate of change: f′(c) is the instantaneous rate of change of f with respect to x at x = _______________.
